name: Arisato Kazuma
source:
Zodiac: Leo

Born and raised an orphan he doesn't know his real name.

Despite being a butler he can't really do anything and is generally made to clean (which gives less then stellar results). He always looks nervous but attempts to be a good-obedient child.
